The authority of life's shade, recording corpses, commanding the dead, and entering a battle stance that heals allies while corroding enemies with life force.

Passive
[Passive - On Learn] Grave Authority: Improves attack damage, attack speed, movement speed, knockback resistance, Presence Sense, and Chant Speed.

[Passive - Toggle] Grave Archive: Grants Naberius Will, Naberius Vision, and Presence Sense, while removing fear, insanity, hypnosis, mind control, burden, webbed, movement interference, and spatial blockade effects.

[Passive - Toggle] Corpse Recording: While toggled, killed enemies are stored in the archive with their HP, EP, Spiritual Health, count, and skills.

[Passive - Toggle] Servant Command: Active summons automatically attack enemies that hit the user or enemies the user attacks.

[Passive - Toggle] Grave Revival: Dead active summons can revive; repeated revivals of the same summon become more expensive.

[Mastery - Passive] Death Veto: While Naberius is toggled, lethal damage is denied, leaving the user alive and granting brief invulnerability, Haki Coat, and Instant Regeneration.

[Mastery - Passive] Corpse-King Authority: Grants Resistance Degradation and a chance to automatically dodge projectiles.

Active
[Active - Press] Grave Archive: Opens the archive menu, allowing the user to select stored corpses, reduce their count, delete them, manifest them, or clear active summons.

[Active - Press] Manifest: Raises selected archive entries as servants. Normal use summons one of each selected corpse; crouching summons as many selected stored copies as possible.

[Active - Press] Chimera Creation: Opens the chimera menu, consuming archived life records to create a stronger servant.

Modes
[Mode] Crimson Eden Warform: Switches from Grave Archive stance into War Stance. This stance strengthens health, attack, defense, speed, recovery, senses, and dodge-related abilities, replacing archive and summon modes with Life Deity combat abilities.

[War Stance] Genesis Pulse: Releases a life-force pulse that heals the user, restores resources, cleanses major mental and movement debuffs, empowers nearby allies, and causes the land nearby to bloom.

[War Stance] Spirit War Step: Dashes forward with spiritual force, damaging enemies ahead, applying Life Seizure, stealing resources, and healing the user based on enemies hit.

[War Stance] Samsara Bloom: Releases a close-range life-and-death burst. Damage increases based on missing HP, applying Organ Decay and Life Seizure, pulling enemies inward, and stealing resources.

[War Stance] Eden of the Life Deity: Hold to charge a divine life domain. While charging, allies are healed and restored; on release, enemies are damaged, pulled inward, afflicted, and drained, while allies, subordinates, summons, and owned mobs are empowered.

[War Stance] Deathless Life Siphon: Marks a target, deals heavy life-force damage, steals resources, and can execute weakened targets with a revive-skipping kill.

[War Stance] Bestow One Life: Grants one forbidden extra life to the user or an ally. When consumed, the target survives lethal damage and gains healing, brief invulnerability, Instant Regeneration, and Haki Coat.

[War Stance] Subordinate Evolution: Force-evolves allied summons, subordinates, tamed mobs, or Naberius servants, improving health, attack, movement, size, resources, and combat power.

[War Stance] Force Awakening: Forces a valid player target through Demon Lord or True Hero awakening.

[War Stance] Fruit of Life: Creates a Fruit of Life. Eating it grants temporary immunity to normal damage, though damage that bypasses invulnerability can still ignore it.

Changes the user's form, allowing them to become a creature far weaker than themselves.

Active
[Active - Press] Morph: Transforms the user into the selected mob. The target must be far weaker than the user.

[Shift + Active] Undo Morph: Cancels the current transformation and restores the user's original form.

A kingly authority over endless imprisonment and time-devouring hunger, weakening enemies, stealing skills, and trapping targets in inescapable space.

Passive
[Passive] Endless Growth: Increases skill learning, mastery progress, and EP gain.

[Passive - Toggle] Magicule Theft: When hitting a player, has a chance to steal part of their temporary Magicules.

[Passive - Toggle] Desperate Empowerment: The lower the user's health becomes, the stronger their strength grows; at critical health, incoming damage is also reduced.

[Passive - Toggle] Endless Pressure: Nearby targets are afflicted with slowness, weakness, and blindness.

[Passive - In Slot] Infinite Prison: Attacks briefly inflict Infinite Imprisonment on the target.

Active
[Active - Press] Taker's Will: Gradually lowers the target's health. Magic Resistance or Magic Nullification reduces the effect.

[Active - Press] Power Hunger: Copies some of the target's skills. Intrinsic, Resistance, Nullification, Common, and Extra skills can be copied, with a chance to copy multiple skills at once.

[Active - Press] Room: Creates a small room-like field. Entities inside are afflicted with a stronger Infinite Imprisonment effect.

[Active - Hold] Isolation: After staring at a target, temporarily disables all of their skills.

[Active - Press] Divine Lifesteal: Deals spatial and holy damage to nearby entities. Matching resistances reduce the damage, while matching nullifications can ignore it.

The authority of the Lord of Time, freezing projectiles, rewriting durations, rewinding self and targets, and detonating enemy Temporal Debt into judgment.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Chrono Divinity: Enhances movement, attack, flight, and chant speed, while granting senses, dodge power, and resistance degradation. Mastery adds Law Degradation and Space Resist Degradation.

[Passive - Toggle] Temporal Isolation: Regularly removes harmful effects from the user. Mastery strengthens the cleansing.

[Passive - Toggle] Projectile Infinity: Stops enemy projectiles before they reach the user. With Mastery, projectiles can be frozen, redirected, or reflected.

[Passive - Toggle] Chrono Prediction: Predicts enemy movement and attacks, creating rejected-future afterimages. With Mastery, threatening enemies are slowed and marked with Future Rejection.

[Passive - Toggle] Stolen Duration: Extends the user's beneficial effects, shortens harmful effects on the user, and weakens enemy buffs nearby.

[Passive - Toggle] Sovereign Time Authority: Enemies that look at, rush, or approach the user are slowed and gain Temporal Stutter and Temporal Debt.

[Passive - Toggle] Chronology Denial: With Mastery, lethal damage can be denied by rewinding the user to an older recorded state.

[Passive - Combat] Temporal Debt: Hitting enemies stores delayed time damage on them. Many Istaroth abilities consume or multiply this stored debt.

Active
[Active - Press] Chronicle: Scans nearby timelines and reports marked enemies, total Temporal Debt, and looped targets. Crouching stores a Manual Anchor for later self-rewind.

[Active - Press] Time Skip: Teleports forward, freezes projectiles along the path, damages enemies in the skipped line, and applies Temporal Stutter and Temporal Debt.

[Crouch + Active] Momentum Theft: Stops projectiles, falling blocks, and enemies in front of the user, stealing their momentum and launching the user forward.

[Active - Press] Borrowed Seconds: Steals duration from enemy buffs, extends enemy debuffs, strengthens the user's buffs, and reduces Istaroth waiting time.

[Crouch + Active] Eternal Moment: Freezes the user's beneficial effects in place, repeatedly extending them for a short time.

[Active - Press] Stillness of the King: The user enters stillness, greatly reducing incoming damage and storing blocked damage as pressure. When stillness ends, nearby enemies are damaged by the stored pressure.

[Crouch + Active] Object Permanence: Freezes a targeted entity, projectile, or falling block in place. Living targets are action-locked and gain Temporal Debt.

[Active - Press] Rewind Self: Restores the user to a Manual Anchor or recent snapshot, restoring position, health, resources, Spiritual Health, and removing harmful effects.

[Crouch + Active] Rewind Target: Rewinds a target to an older position or state. Allies can be restored, while enemies are punished with Temporal Stutter, action lock, and Temporal Debt.

[Active - Press] Delayed Verdict: Marks a target and stores damage they take. When the timer ends, stored damage plus Temporal Debt detonates as Timeline Verdict.

[Crouch + Active] Effect Before Cause: Damages a target before the cause occurs, applying Future Rejection and heavy Temporal Debt.

[Active - Press] Twenty-Second Causality Loop: Records nearby enemies, then plays their timeline backward, repeatedly snapping them to previous positions and adding Temporal Debt.

[Crouch + Active] Condemned Repeat: Anchors a target to one moment. If they move too far, move too fast, or try to escape, they are snapped back and punished.

[Active - Press] Future Exile: Removes a target from the current moment, making them invisible, frozen, and no-physics for a short time. When they return, they take damage and Temporal Stutter.

[Crouch + Active] Past Burial: Buries a target in their past, locking actions, applying Event Silence, and adding Temporal Debt.

[Active - Hold] World of Still Seconds: Creates a stopped-world field around the user. Enemies, projectiles, and falling blocks are frozen, slowed, silenced, rejected from the future, and loaded with Temporal Debt.

[Active after Holding] Clockbreak Release: Releases the stopped world, detonating frozen force, projectiles, held time, and Temporal Debt into a large causality explosion.

[Mastery - Active] Last Second of Creation: Declares the final second, forming a massive doom storm. Time accelerates violently, gravity dies, entities are lifted, projectiles freeze, enemies are silenced and rejected from the future, and the future collapses into a huge final detonation.

A parasitic skill that studies status effects, stores them as fungal samples, upgrades them, and spreads them to nearby enemies through poisonous spores.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Spore Aura: While toggled, the user periodically releases a fungal aura that affects nearby enemies. Enemies are inflicted with Paralysis, poisonous spores appear around them, and small mushroom patches may grow nearby.

If the user has stored analyzed effects, the aura releases additional poison spores. The more effects stored, the stronger the aura appears.

Active
[Active - Press] Analyze: Samples a random active effect from the target the user is looking at. Crouching analyzes the user instead. The sampled effect is stored in fungal memory; analyzing the same effect again increases its stored count.

[Active - Press] Workshop: Opens the Fungus Infection GUI, showing stored effects, upgrade state, available upgrade points, and the currently configured workshop effects.

[Active - Press] Configure: Creates a workshop loadout from stored effects. Normal users can configure fewer effects, while Mastery allows more. Crouching clears the workshop. The workshop determines which effects Spread can use.

[Active - Press] Spread: Spreads workshop effects to nearby enemies. Crouching applies effects to the user instead. Each use randomly selects effects from the workshop and applies them to nearby targets.

Upgrade
Each analyzed effect has its own stored count. Stored counts can be spent to improve that effect's duration or amplifier.

Workshop
The workshop is the selected list of effects that Spread can use. The GUI lets the player assign analyzed effects into workshop slots.
